notes: Fixes an iPhone/PWA Daily Operations scrolling problem where a large spontaneous upward jump could interrupt a user who was actively scrolling downward. A scroll-stability guard now rejects only those large unintended upward jumps during a downward finger gesture while preserving normal upward scrolling and deliberate Today/Tomorrow/Full Itinerary navigation. The Daily Operations offline cache was bumped so the fix is fetched cleanly. No Vault or checklist data is changed.
name: TEE v3.5.22 — Daily Operations Scroll Stability
